real_defects.issue: findDate returned impossible dates: an ISO date was returned as typed ('2026-13-45', '2026-02-30'), and 'YYYY/MM/DD', 'DD.MM.YYYY', 'M/D/YYYY' and 'the 31st' let Date.UTC roll a missing day into the next month ('2026/02/31' -> 2026-03-03; 'the 31st' on 10 Nov -> 1 Dec; 'the 0th' -> 30 Nov; 'the 99th' -> a February date); 'in 1 month' from 31 Jan gave 3 Mar. A follow-up was scheduled on a day the person never named.

A reply saying 'back in 99999999 days' (or 'in 9999999 months') made iso() throw RangeError: Invalid time value from inside triage, so one stranger's reply stopped runInbox for the whole inbox; 'in 999999 months' returned the malformed date '+085360-02'.
